description: Paying for a year is switched off on this server, so this always answers PAYMENT_DISABLED. Use renew_subdomain, which is free and adds a month.

owner_token.description: The owner token you were given when you created the record (starts with anon_). Omit it only if you have an API key, or if the record predates tokens and was claimed from this same IP address. Creating without one mints a new one and returns it once.

payment.description: The x402 payment payload, base64 — the X-PAYMENT header value. Omit to be told what to pay.

name: extend_subdomain
